name: George Eliot
q: Nothing is so good as it seems
One gets a bad habit of being unhappy
Those who trust us educate us
Be poor to know the luxury of giving
Many victories are worse than defeat
Childhood is why we love the earth
The happiest women have no history
One draught of pity beats all wisdom
We live to ease one another's life
Our deeds make us as we make them
The dead die only when forgotten
Steady work becomes its own end
There is unmapped country within us
The root of growth is human choice
World's good rests on hidden lives
